name: Mage Armor, Greater
body:
School conjuration (creation) [force]; Level bloodrager 3, psychic 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner/unchained summoner 3, witch 3

DESCRIPTION

This spells acts as mage armor except the armor bonus provided is +4 plus 1 per three caster levels to a maximum of +8 at 12th level.
